title: Juicy Argentinian Fish Braise
description: A kid-friendly argentinian dish featuring fish sauce nam pla and a dairy-free friendly braise. The bitter flavors are balanced by the juiciness of the fish.

ingredients.name: Snapper fillets
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, skin off, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the fish pieces until golden brown on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Remove the fish from the pot and set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook until they are dark brown and caramelized, about 15 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers to the pot and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the fish sauce nam pla, beer, and diced tomatoes to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the fish to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 12-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the fish hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
